items.purpose: Estimate the current and near-term activity state from a broad monthly information set.
items.intermediate_claim: US real activity is accelerating or decelerating.

items.purpose: Estimate the lower tail of future real GDP growth conditional on financial conditions.
items.intermediate_claim: US growth downside risk is elevated or contained.

items.purpose: Estimate persistence and the near-term direction of inflation with registered price and activity factors.
items.intermediate_claim: US inflation is accelerating or decelerating.

items.purpose: Estimate the dynamic response of inflation to registered energy-price innovations.
items.intermediate_claim: Energy shocks are adding to or subtracting from near-term inflation pressure.

items.purpose: Measure recent WTI innovations and provide the registered shock series for pass-through analysis.
items.intermediate_claim: The latest energy impulse is inflationary or disinflationary.

items.purpose: Measure the labor-market state from payrolls, unemployment, claims, vacancies, hiring and wages.
items.intermediate_claim: The labor market is tight, balanced or soft.

items.purpose: Estimate the joint dynamics of yields, curve slope, inflation, activity and financial conditions.
items.intermediate_claim: Financial conditions are easing or tightening and transmit to growth.

items.purpose: Measure debt-stock and rate co-movement without asserting an unidentified causal effect.
items.intermediate_claim: Treasury supply pressure is rising or falling.

items.purpose: Exercise the panel fixed-effects contract on a real ten-state panel; excluded from general synthesis.
items.intermediate_claim: State HPI growth and unemployment are conditionally associated in this fixture.

items.purpose: Estimate production momentum from industrial production, broad activity and payroll evidence.
items.intermediate_claim: The production side of the US economy is accelerating or decelerating.

items.purpose: Estimate household-demand momentum from real consumption, real income, retail sales and saving.
items.intermediate_claim: US household demand is strengthening or weakening.

items.purpose: Estimate the interest-sensitive housing cycle from permits, starts and the yield-curve/financial-condition channel.
items.intermediate_claim: US housing construction is strengthening or weakening.

items.purpose: Estimate vacancy and hiring momentum from official JOLTS openings, hires and quits.
items.intermediate_claim: US labor demand through vacancies and hiring is strengthening or weakening.

items.purpose: Estimate displacement pressure from layoffs, initial claims and continuing claims.
items.intermediate_claim: US worker displacement pressure is increasing or decreasing.

items.purpose: Estimate aggregate and AI-sensitive-sector wage adjustment.
items.intermediate_claim: US wage pressure is accelerating or decelerating across aggregate and AI-sensitive sectors.

items.purpose: Measure whether youth and education-group labor outcomes are diverging.
items.intermediate_claim: Labor-market deterioration is concentrated in younger or more educated cohorts.

items.purpose: Compare vacancies, layoffs, employment and wages in information and professional services.
items.intermediate_claim: AI-sensitive sectors exhibit unusual labor-demand, displacement or wage patterns.

items.purpose: Measure Census BTOS AI adoption by registered strata and vintage.
items.intermediate_claim: US business AI adoption is broadening or slowing.

items.purpose: Test registered associations between AI adoption and sector vacancies, layoffs, employment or wages without causal interpretation.
items.intermediate_claim: AI adoption is associated with sector labor expansion or displacement.

items.purpose: Estimate an adoption/exposure event study only after treatment timing, overlap, pre-trend and clustering prerequisites pass.
items.intermediate_claim: AI adoption caused a change in US unemployment for exposed groups.

items.purpose: Measure credit-spread and broad financial-condition amplification of labor and activity risk.
items.intermediate_claim: Credit conditions are amplifying or dampening real-economy downside risk.

items.purpose: Separate the expected short-rate path from long-end yield pressure.
items.intermediate_claim: Policy-rate expectations are adding to or subtracting from long-yield pressure.

items.purpose: Decompose nominal long-yield pressure into real-rate, inflation-compensation and term-premium components.
items.intermediate_claim: Real-rate and term-premium components are lifting or lowering the nominal 10-year yield.

items.purpose: Test whether broad financial conditions amplify or offset Treasury yield pressure.
items.intermediate_claim: Liquidity and financial conditions are amplifying or cushioning long-yield pressure.

items.purpose: Estimate the direction of market-implied long-horizon inflation expectations.
items.intermediate_claim: Inflation expectations are adding to or subtracting from nominal yield pressure.

items.purpose: Reconcile nominal yields with real yields and inflation compensation.
items.intermediate_claim: Inflation compensation explains a rising or falling share of nominal long-yield pressure.

items.purpose: Test whether realized inflation persistence and activity are reinforcing the long-rate path.
items.intermediate_claim: Demand-sensitive inflation pressure is lifting or lowering the expected rate path.

items.purpose: Measure the persistence of debt-stock and debt-to-GDP expansion.
items.intermediate_claim: The federal debt trajectory is increasing or reducing financing pressure.

items.purpose: Connect net federal saving and borrowing requirements to long-yield pressure.
items.intermediate_claim: Federal financing flows are adding to or subtracting from Treasury supply pressure.

items.purpose: Test whether duration absorption appears in the 10-year term premium and the long end of the curve.
items.intermediate_claim: Duration absorption and the term premium are lifting or lowering long yields.

items.purpose: Estimate one-day, one-week and one-month direction for broad US equity indices with time-ordered out-of-sample validation.
items.intermediate_claim: Broad US equities have a positive or negative registered near-term directional tilt.

items.purpose: Estimate whether volatility, credit spreads and broad financial stress amplify or cushion equity downside.
items.intermediate_claim: Volatility and risk appetite are supporting or opposing US equity returns.

items.purpose: Estimate the predictive association of Treasury yields, real rates and the dollar with broad US equity returns.
items.intermediate_claim: Discount-rate and dollar conditions are adding to or subtracting from broad US equity returns.

items.purpose: Estimate short-horizon direction for US energy prices using real daily spot-market proxies and time-ordered validation.
items.intermediate_claim: The registered US commodity price complex has a positive or negative near-term directional tilt.

items.purpose: Estimate how US crude inventories and linked energy prices describe physical-market tightness.
items.intermediate_claim: The physical US energy balance is tightening or loosening.

items.purpose: Estimate dollar, rate and real-demand transmission into energy and industrial commodity prices.
items.intermediate_claim: Dollar, rates and demand conditions are supporting or opposing US commodity prices.

items.purpose: Estimate diversified time-series momentum only after point-in-time continuous futures returns and roll conventions are registered.
items.intermediate_claim: Registered futures trends carry a persistent directional premium after costs and roll treatment.

items.purpose: Estimate the storage, inventory and convenience-yield equilibrium only after contract-level spot and futures curves are available.
items.intermediate_claim: Storage scarcity and convenience yield explain the observed futures curve.

items.purpose: Test inventory, basis and risk-premium interactions after a vintage-safe basis series is registered.
items.intermediate_claim: Inventory tightness changes basis and expected commodity returns.

items.purpose: Decompose oil futures slope and curvature only after individual contract maturities and expiry-aware rolls are registered.
items.intermediate_claim: Oil curve slope and curvature identify near-term tightness and longer-run expectations.

items.purpose: Estimate equity responses around FOMC announcements only after intraday event timestamps, clean windows and surprise measures are registered.
items.intermediate_claim: Unexpected monetary-policy news moves US equity prices within a registered event window.

items.purpose: Forecast US sector returns only after investable sector total-return series, release-vintage predictors and a leakage-safe panel are registered.
items.intermediate_claim: Registered macro-financial predictors differentiate subsequent US sector returns out of sample.
